name: PVS Compactification and Temporal Coherence Pass
aliases: PVS compactification and temporal coherence pass
definition: Compute shader pass that compactifies potentially visible block indices and generates current and previous frame PVS data for temporal coherence.
summary: This compute shader pass compactifies raw visibility indices into current and newly visible block sets, differing from sibling methods by focusing on temporal data structure construction rather than initial geometric tests.
